repo.purpose: Compact machine-readable progress and lessons record for the user's own long-running Codex experiment to earn verified net revenue of 100 RMB or equivalent USD.

not a place where humans review or approve ordinary agent strategy

support_policy.public_repo_privacy_rule: Do not store payer names, account identifiers, full transaction IDs, or private payment details in the public repository.
support_policy.formal_payment_integration_rule: Use an Alipay payment integration skill only when the user explicitly requests formal ordering, callbacks, reconciliation, H5/App/scan payment, or similar payment-product integration.

hard_boundaries: Do not count views, favorites, posts, proposal drafts, prepared materials, platform setup, tips, donations, support payments, or inquiries without order/payment as experiment revenue.
Do not solve CAPTCHA or ask for verification codes inside an automated maintenance task.
Do not pay for bids, membership, promotion, deposit, guarantee, or platform credits without explicit user confirmation.
Do not alter payment, tax, profile, or account settings without explicit user confirmation.
Do not fabricate experience, promise guaranteed outcomes, or provide real bank/company internal materials.
Do not go off-platform for payment when platform rules require on-platform handling.
next_safe_plan: Keep existing Xianyu, X/Twitter, Tieba, ZBJ, and EPWK surfaces as low-frequency monitors only.
If the user explicitly confirms a PeoplePerHour attempt, use one Chrome tab and stop for login, CAPTCHA, ID, phone/SMS, payment, tax, or profile setup.
If a real buyer appears, stop broad searching and route the buyer toward a compliant on-platform order.
If payment or payout appears, verify evidence before updating revenue_ledger.csv.

file_policy.PROGRESS.md: English human spectator/progress page; not an approval file.
file_policy.PROGRESS.zh-CN.md: Chinese human spectator/progress page; not an approval file.
file_policy.SKILL.md: Root AgentSkills-compatible skill for watching progress, reusing lessons, and explaining support boundaries. It should remain read-only and script-free unless the user explicitly approves a design change.
file_policy.skills/agent-employment-guide/SKILL.md: Tap-compatible copy for agents that scan skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
file_policy.AGENTS.md: Generic entry instructions for any agent runtime reading this repository.
file_policy.SUPPORT.md: Public support/tip entry points and privacy/accounting boundaries.
file_policy.assets/support/alipay-qr.jpg: Public Alipay support QR asset. Support payments do not count as experiment revenue.
file_policy.assets/support/wechat-pay-qr.jpg: Public WeChat Pay support QR asset. Support payments do not count as experiment revenue.
file_policy..gitignore: Keeps private ledgers, payment evidence, tax records, and secrets out of the public repository.
